sub_sections.title: Whats happening?How do I fix it?
sub_sections.description_text:
So you go about your play-through collecting your logs and then all the sudden your logs are reset or you stop getting the achievements or even the next log is not active. You ask why is this happening? Well I don't know why to be honest but it does happen and has been happening since the OG release of Halo ODST back in 2009.
    ''Okay well how do i fix it? I've looked all over Reddit and the forums but cant find a solution.'' Well ill tell you but you might not be to happy. First of all lets say you collect log #20 and no achievement pops this is because the game didn't log that interaction as the 20th log. Instead a random log location #1-29 will relight back up and you'll have to go back through all 1-29 log locations to find it or find them if you have more then one that didn't pop. It suck i know who wants to back track but trust this is the case and no matter how painful it is to walk around the streets looking for a rouge log its the only way to get the log to pop an achievement.
Note: You will know its the correct log location when the detour signs are present indicating your next log is here.
